name: Casper
source:
A black cat who accompanies Libitina.

Calm and composed, it subtly supports the somewhat laid-back Libitina while still standing in the way of the heroine and her companions.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
